lunar_events.description: Fresh beginnings with practical, ambitious energy

retrogrades.description: Rethinking creative projects and leadership approaches

01-01.celestial_highlights: 🌑 New Moon in Capricorn brings structured new beginnings. Mars retrograde in Leo calls for patience in creative endeavors.
01-01.overall_interpretation: Start the year with grounded intentions while reviewing past creative projects. Perfect time for practical goal-setting with creative patience.

retrogrades.description: Continued reflection on self-expression and leadership

01-02.celestial_highlights: ♂ Mars retrograde continues in Leo, encouraging inner reflection on personal power and creative expression.
01-02.overall_interpretation: Focus on internal creative work and reassessing how you express your unique talents. Avoid rushing into new leadership roles.

retrogrades.description: Deep dive into personal creative blocks and ego patterns

01-03.celestial_highlights: 🦁 Mars retrograde in Leo deepens, perfect for examining ego patterns and creative blocks that limit self-expression.
01-03.overall_interpretation: Excellent day for creative therapy, journaling about self-expression, and healing relationship with personal power.

retrogrades.description: Reviewing past creative decisions and leadership styles

01-04.celestial_highlights: ⭐ Mars retrograde continues its journey through Leo, asking you to review and refine your creative approach.
01-04.overall_interpretation: Review past creative projects and leadership decisions. What worked? What didn't? Use this insight to improve your approach.

retrogrades.description: Patience with creative timing and self-expression

01-05.celestial_highlights: 🎭 Mars retrograde in Leo teaches patience with creative timing and authentic self-expression.
01-05.overall_interpretation: Trust divine timing in creative matters. Focus on internal development rather than external creative output.

lunar_events.description: Taking action on new year intentions with fiery determination

retrogrades.description: Balancing action urges with retrograde reflection

01-06.celestial_highlights: 🌓 First Quarter Moon in Aries creates tension between action-oriented energy and Mars retrograde's call for reflection.
01-06.overall_interpretation: Balance your desire to take action with the need for continued reflection. Channel Aries energy into planning rather than execution.

retrogrades.description: Integrating lessons about personal power and creativity

01-07.celestial_highlights: 🔥 Mars retrograde in Leo continues teaching important lessons about authentic self-expression and personal power.
01-07.overall_interpretation: Integrate recent insights about your creative gifts and leadership style. Prepare for future action with this new wisdom.

retrogrades.description: Refining understanding of ego versus authentic self

01-08.celestial_highlights: 👑 Mars retrograde in Leo helps distinguish between ego-driven actions and authentic self-expression.
01-08.overall_interpretation: Examine your motivations: Are you acting from ego or authentic self? This awareness will improve all future creative endeavors.

retrogrades.description: Preparing for eventual forward movement with greater wisdom

01-09.celestial_highlights: ⚡ Mars retrograde in Leo nears its integration phase, preparing you for wiser action in creative and leadership areas.
01-09.overall_interpretation: You're nearing the end of this reflection phase. Soon you'll be ready to act on your creative insights with greater authenticity.

retrogrades.description: Final integration of creative and leadership lessons

ingresses.description: Love becomes more spiritual, compassionate, and intuitive

01-10.celestial_highlights: ♀ Venus enters Pisces bringing spiritual love energy, while Mars retrograde completes its Leo lessons.
01-10.overall_interpretation: Venus in Pisces adds compassionate, spiritual love energy as you complete important lessons about authentic self-expression.

retrogrades.description: Continuing creative reflection with new Venus in Pisces influence

01-11.celestial_highlights: 🌊 Venus in Pisces begins influencing relationships with spiritual love, while Mars retrograde continues in Leo.
01-11.overall_interpretation: Spiritual love and compassion can heal creative blocks. Approach your artistic endeavors with more heart-centered energy.

retrogrades.description: Blending heart-centered approach with creative expression

01-12.celestial_highlights: 💖 Venus in Pisces softens Mars retrograde's intensity, bringing heart-centered wisdom to creative reflection.
01-12.overall_interpretation: Let love and compassion guide your creative process. Heart-centered creativity is more authentic and sustainable.

lunar_events.description: Emotional culmination and nurturing energy peak

retrogrades.description: Full moon illuminates emotional aspects of creative blocks

01-13.celestial_highlights: 🌕 Full Moon in Cancer illuminates emotional needs while Mars retrograde in Leo reveals how emotions affect creativity.
01-13.overall_interpretation: Full moon brings emotional clarity about what nurtures your creative soul. Pay attention to feelings about self-expression.

retrogrades.description: Integrating emotional insights with creative expression

01-14.celestial_highlights: 🌙 Post-full moon energy helps integrate emotional insights revealed during Cancer full moon with Mars retrograde lessons.
01-14.overall_interpretation: Use yesterday's emotional revelations to understand your creative needs better. Nurture your artistic side with compassion.

retrogrades.description: Preparing for Mars station direct later this month

01-15.celestial_highlights: ⚡ Mars retrograde in Leo begins preparing for its station direct, building energy for future creative action.
01-15.overall_interpretation: Start planning how you'll apply your creative insights once Mars goes direct. Energy is building for forward movement.
